name: Galaxy Z Flip 8

images.credit: Kyu3a, CC BY-SA 4.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Network.SIM: Nano-SIM + eSIM + eSIM (max 2 at a time)

Platform.Operating system: Android 17, up to 7 major Android upgrades, One UI 9
Platform.Chipset: Z Flip 8 (USA/China): Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 (3 nm), Z Flip 8 (Worldwide): Samsung Exynos 2600 (2 nm)
Platform.GPU: Z Flip 8 (USA/China): Adreno 840, Z Flip 8 (Worldwide): Xclipse 960

Display.Display: Foldable Dynamic LTPO AMOLED 2X, 120Hz, HDR10+, 2600 nits (peak), 6.9 inches, 111.2 cm2 (~88.7% screen-to-body ratio), 1080 x 2520 pixels, 21:9 ratio (~397 ppi density)

Cameras.Rear camera: 50 MP, f/1.8, 23 mm (wide), 1/1.57", 1.0 μm, dual pixel PDAF, OIS, 12 MP, f/2.2, 13 mm, 123° (ultrawide), 1/3.2", 1.12 μm, LED flash, HDR, panorama, 4K@30/60fps, 1080p@60/120/240fps, 720p@960fps, HDR10+

Battery.Charging: 25W wired (50% in 30 min), QC2.0, 15W wireless, 4.5W reverse wireless

Connectivity.Connectivity: Wi-Fi 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac/6e/7, tri-band, Wi-Fi Direct, Bluetooth 5.4, A2DP, LE, GPS, GALILEO, GLONASS, BDS, QZSS, USB Type-C 3.2 Gen 1, OTG
